# kea_subnet (Resource)

A Kea DHCP subnet (KeaSubnet CR): its pool(s), routers, DNS, and PXE/boot options.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kea_subnet" "lab" {
  name        = "lab"
  cluster_ref = "primary"
  subnet      = "192.0.2.0/24"

  pools          = ["192.0.2.100-192.0.2.200"]
  routers        = ["192.0.2.1"]
  dns_servers    = ["192.0.2.53"]
  domain_name    = "lab.example.com"
  valid_lifetime = 3600

  # PXE boot options
  next_server    = "192.0.2.1"
  boot_file_name = "pxelinux.0"
  client_classes = ["pxeclients"]

  option_data = [
    {
      name = "tftp-server-name"
      code = 66
      data = "192.0.2.1"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stable resource id (the KeaSubnet CR name).
- `subnet` (String) Subnet in CIDR notation, e.g. 192.0.2.0/24.

### Optional

- `boot_file_name` (String) PXE boot file name.
- `client_classes` (List of String) Client classes required to receive a lease from this subnet.
- `cluster_ref` (String) Name of the KeaCluster this subnet belongs to.
- `dns_servers` (List of String) DNS server addresses (domain-name-servers option).
- `domain_name` (String) Domain name handed to clients.
- `next_server` (String) PXE next-server (siaddr / TFTP server) address.
- `option_data` (Attributes List) Extra DHCP options applied to this subnet. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--option_data))
- `pools` (List of String) Address pools, e.g. ["192.0.2.100-192.0.2.200"].
- `routers` (List of String) Default gateway addresses (DHCP option routers).
- `subnet_id` (Number) Numeric Kea subnet id. Omit to let Kea assign one.
- `valid_lifetime` (Number) Lease valid lifetime in seconds.

<a id="nestedatt--option_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `option_data`

Required:

- `data` (String) Option value.

Optional:

- `code` (Number) Numeric option code.
- `name` (String) Option name.
- `space` (String) Option space.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a subnet by its name.
terraform import kea_subnet.lab lab
```
